latex:
设 $\Gamma$ 是空间圆周
\[
\begin{cases}
x^2+y^2+z^2=a^2,\\
x+y+z=\frac{3}{2}a
\end{cases}
\quad (a>0),
\]
则
\[
\oint_{\Gamma} (2yz+2zx+2xy)\,ds=\underline{\hspace{4em}}.
\]
